```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll("table.calendar tbody tr");
  var today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  var next = null;
  rows.forEach(function (row) {
    var cells = row.querySelectorAll("td");
    if (!cells[0].textContent.trim()) { row.classList.add("break-row"); return; }
    var m = cells[1].textContent.match(/(\d+)\s+(\w{3})\w*\s+(\d{4})/);
    if (!m) return;
    var months = {Jan:0,Feb:1,Mar:2,Apr:3,May:4,Jun:5,Jul:6,Aug:7,Sep:8,Oct:9,Nov:10,Dec:11};
    var d = new Date(+m[3], months[m[2]], +m[1]);
    if (d < today) row.classList.add("past-row");
    else if (!next) { next = row; row.classList.add("next-row"); }
  });
  var box = document.getElementById("next-session");
  if (!box) return;
  if (next) {
    var c = next.querySelectorAll("td");
    var link = c[3].querySelector("a");
    box.innerHTML = "<span class='next-date'>" + c[1].textContent + "</span><br>" +
      "Session " + c[0].textContent + " · " + c[2].textContent +
      (link ? " · <a href='" + link.getAttribute("href") + "'>slides</a>" : "");
  } else {
    box.textContent = "All 22 sessions are done.";
  }
});
</script>
```
